adjusted_model.note: Model with punctuation such as hyphens, slashes, and parentheses replaced by spaces; preserve the sibling-row spacing convention.

sku_type_complete.note: Corrected 2026-09-23: the live refrigerator_dict_new table has NO `type` column -- the prior version of this file referenced one and was stale/inapplicable. Confirmed against live sibling rows (e.g. brand=Lg model=GN-B452PMFK -> sku_type_complete='Lg GN-B452PMFK'; brand=Haier model=HM606SKMY -> 'Haier HM606SKMY'): sku_type_complete is simply `brand` + ' ' + `model` (raw model, punctuation preserved), regardless of door_type/net_ltrs_total/volume_in -- those columns are NOT appended. Multi-model listings (2+ colour/model codes in one title) use a dedicated 'Multi Variant' dict row (model='Multi Variant', sku_type_complete='<Brand> Multi Variant') rather than concatenating multiple codes.

keywords.note: Confirmed live: keywords = ' ' + brand + ' ' + model + ' ' + adjusted_model (leading space is part of the stored value).
